boundaryZh: 本文件记录 EcoMOF-AI 的方法灵感、需求分类和证据边界；除明确标注为 validated literature 的条目外，不作为候选材料性能证明。
boundaryEn: This file records method inspiration, requirement classes, and evidence boundaries for EcoMOF-AI. Unless marked as validated literature, entries are not performance evidence for any candidate material.

categories.purposeZh: 解释为什么 EcoMOF-AI 采用证据分层、字段溯源、结构化因素效应和小样本验证闭环。
categories.purposeEn: Explains why EcoMOF-AI uses evidence tiers, field provenance, structured factor effects, and small-sample validation loops.

categories.purposeZh: 把吸附性能、工作容量、再生负担、稳定性、绿色合成、LCA/LCC 与金属供应风险拆成可检查的数据需求。
categories.purposeEn: Splits adsorption performance, working capacity, regeneration burden, stability, green synthesis, LCA/LCC, and metal-supply risk into inspectable data requirements.

categories.purposeZh: 支撑 GasSep 不只展示容量，还联动选择性、工作容量、再生性、吸附热和证据等级。
categories.purposeEn: Supports GasSep using selectivity, working capacity, regenerability, heat of adsorption, and evidence level rather than uptake alone.

categories.purposeZh: 保留原有有机酸/催化文献灵感，包括腔内/表面机制、耦合描述符热区图和验证梯度。
categories.purposeEn: Preserves the original organic-acid and catalysis inspiration, including in-cavity/surface mechanisms, coupled-descriptor hot spots, and validation ladders.

categories.titleZh: 数据质量、验证与报告边界
categories.titleEn: Data Quality, Validation, And Reporting Boundary
categories.purposeZh: 把文献、实验、模拟、演示和待核验数据分开处理，避免把排序解释误读为最终推荐。
categories.purposeEn: Separates literature, experimental, simulated, demonstration, and pending data so ranking explanations are not misread as final recommendations.

sources.title: Data-Driven Design of Metal-Organic Frameworks for Efficient Coalbed Methane Purification: From Molecular Fingerprint Mining to Experimental Validation
sources.authors: Guoqiang Che; Pengtao Guo; Miao Chang; Qingyuan Yang; Dahuan Liu
sources.coreIdeaZh: 将分子指纹挖掘、反向设计与实验验证串联起来的数据驱动 MOF 设计路线。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Data-driven MOF design links molecular fingerprint mining, reverse design, and experimental validation.
sources.adoptedInZh: 描述符驱动候选解释、验证证据梯度、小样本验证路线。
sources.adoptedInEn: Descriptor-driven candidate interpretation, validation evidence ladder, and small-sample validation route.
sources.boundaryZh: 仅借鉴工作流，不复现 CH4/N2 分离模型或 Ni-BIC 结果。
sources.boundaryEn: Workflow-level inspiration only; EcoMOF-AI does not reproduce the CH4/N2 model or Ni-BIC result.

sources.title: AI-Powered Experimental Discovery of Metal-Organic Frameworks for n/i-Butane Separation
sources.coreIdeaZh: 用 integrated descriptors 与相似性采样降低筛选成本，并保持描述符可由实验或模拟获得。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Integrated descriptors and similarity-based sampling reduce screening cost while keeping descriptors experimentally or computationally accessible.
sources.adoptedInZh: 小规模真实样例、CoRE/QMOF 映射、描述符覆盖审查。
sources.adoptedInEn: Small real examples, CoRE/QMOF mapping, and descriptor-coverage review.
sources.boundaryZh: 目标是 n/i-butane 分离；元数据核查前不作为 DOI-backed 证据引用。
sources.boundaryEn: Target is n/i-butane separation; do not cite as DOI-backed evidence until metadata is verified.

sources.title: The geometric-electronic coupled design of diatomic catalyst towards oxygen reduction reaction
sources.authors: Yan Liu; Yan Yang; Xuanni Lin; Yutao Lin; Zhiwen Zhuo; Dong Liu; Junjie Mao; Jun Jiang
sources.coreIdeaZh: 用几何与电子描述符构建催化热区图，辅助双原子催化剂设计。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Uses geometric and electronic descriptors to build catalytic hot-spot maps for diatomic catalyst design.
sources.adoptedInZh: 耦合描述符热区图、支架图/掺杂图/协同图、验证梯度。
sources.adoptedInEn: Coupled-descriptor hot-spot map, scaffold/dopant/synergy views, and validation ladder.
sources.boundaryZh: 只借鉴可视化哲学，不复现 ORR 模型、DFT 数据集或实验结论。
sources.boundaryEn: Visualization philosophy only; EcoMOF-AI does not reproduce the ORR model, DFT dataset, or experimental claim.

sources.title: Modelling and estimation of chemical reaction yields from high-throughput experiments
sources.coreIdeaZh: 高通量化学数据具有数据生成结构，直接黑箱建模容易产生误导。
sources.coreIdeaEn: High-throughput chemical data has a data-generation structure, and black-box modeling can be misleading if that structure is ignored.
sources.adoptedInZh: 数据质量门控、结构化因素效应、稳健性审计和解释边界。
sources.adoptedInEn: Data-quality gates, structured factor effects, robustness audit, and interpretation boundaries.
sources.boundaryZh: 讨论 HTE 产率建模，不是 MOF 筛选或有机酸性能证据。
sources.boundaryEn: Addresses HTE yield modeling, not MOF screening or organic-acid performance evidence.

sources.title: Machine Learning Reveals In-Cavity Versus Surface Activity for Selective C-H Borylation by Metal-Organic Framework Catalysts
sources.coreIdeaZh: 用可解释 MOF 描述符族区分腔内活性、表面活性和缺陷位点活性。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Uses interpretable MOF descriptor families to distinguish in-cavity activity from surface or defect-site activity.
sources.adoptedInZh: 腔内/表面/缺陷机制分支、机理雷达和活性位点解释。
sources.adoptedInEn: In-cavity/surface/defect mechanism branches, mechanism radar, and active-site explanation.
sources.boundaryZh: 研究 Ni-MOF C-H borylation，不是 CO2 到有机酸路径证明。
sources.boundaryEn: Studies Ni-MOF C-H borylation, not proof for CO2-to-organic-acid pathways.

sources.title: Determining objective weights in multiple criteria problems: The CRITIC method
sources.authors: D. Diakoulaki; G. Mavrotas; L. Papayannakis
sources.coreIdeaZh: CRITIC 用指标差异度和指标冲突度生成客观权重。
sources.coreIdeaEn: CRITIC derives objective weights from contrast intensity and conflict among criteria.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen / GasSep 中解释 CRITIC 权重来源和敏感性边界。
sources.adoptedInEn: Explains the origin and sensitivity boundary of CRITIC weights in EcoScreen / GasSep.
sources.boundaryZh: CRITIC 解释排序影响，不证明化学因果机制。
sources.boundaryEn: CRITIC explains ranking influence, not chemical causality.

sources.title: Large-scale screening of hypothetical metal-organic frameworks
sources.coreIdeaZh: 大规模 MOF 早筛应把结构描述符、吸附模拟和任务目标联系起来。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Large-scale MOF screening links structural descriptors, adsorption simulation, and task targets.
sources.adoptedInZh: Open MOF Seed 候选覆盖、结构描述符覆盖和 Top-N 预览边界。
sources.adoptedInEn: Open MOF Seed coverage, structural descriptor coverage, and Top-N preview boundaries.
sources.boundaryZh: 不表示当前候选已完成同等 GCMC 或过程模拟。
sources.boundaryEn: Does not imply the current candidates have equivalent GCMC or process simulation.

sources.title: Development and evaluation of porous materials for carbon dioxide separation and capture
sources.coreIdeaZh: CO2 分离评价不能只看单点吸附量，还应关注选择性、工作容量和再生代价。
sources.coreIdeaEn: CO2 separation evaluation should consider selectivity, working capacity, and regeneration burden, not uptake alone.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 和 GasSep 将吸附量、选择性、工作容量、再生性拆开展示。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen and GasSep separate uptake, selectivity, working capacity, and regenerability.
sources.boundaryZh: 当前缺字段时只提示数据缺口，不伪造 IAST/GCMC 结果。
sources.boundaryEn: When fields are missing, EcoMOF-AI flags data gaps instead of fabricating IAST/GCMC results.

sources.title: Water stability and adsorption in metal-organic frameworks
sources.authors: Nicholas C. Burtch; Harpale S. Jasuja; Krista S. Walton
sources.coreIdeaZh: 水稳定性会决定湿气、烟道气或水相条件下的 MOF 适用性。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Water stability determines MOF applicability under humid, flue-gas, or aqueous conditions.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 把水稳定性从普通描述符提升为应用门槛和数据缺口。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen treats water stability as an application gate and data-gap dimension.
sources.boundaryZh: 水稳定性缺失不等于材料失败，但必须进入复核队列。
sources.boundaryEn: Missing water-stability data does not mean material failure, but it must enter the review queue.

sources.title: Green synthesis of metal-organic frameworks: A state-of-the-art review of potential environmental and medical applications
sources.authors: Sandeep Kumar; Shikha Jain; Monika Nehra; Neeraj Dilbaghi; Giovanna Marrazza; Ki Hyun Kim
sources.coreIdeaZh: 绿色 MOF 合成需要关注溶剂、温度、时间、产率、活化步骤和后处理。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Green MOF synthesis requires attention to solvent, temperature, time, yield, activation, and post-processing.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 新增绿色合成字段覆盖，而不把缺失字段直接写入最终分数。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen adds green-synthesis field coverage without writing missing fields directly into the final score.
sources.boundaryZh: 当前没有完整工艺清单时只能作为接入需求和早筛缺口。
sources.boundaryEn: Without a full process inventory, this is a data-ingestion requirement and early-screening gap.

sources.title: Life-cycle assessment as a tool for eco-design of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs)
sources.authors: Carlos A. Grande; Richard Blom; Aud I. Spjelkavik; Valentine Moreau; Jerome Payet
sources.coreIdeaZh: CO2 捕集材料评价需要生命周期视角，避免只看使用阶段性能。
sources.coreIdeaEn: CO2-capture materials need life-cycle framing rather than use-phase performance alone.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 显示 LCA 边界、功能单位和清单字段缺口。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen displays gaps in LCA boundary, functional unit, and inventory fields.
sources.boundaryZh: 没有完整 LCI 时，不输出工程级 LCA 结论。
sources.boundaryEn: Without a complete LCI, EcoMOF-AI does not output engineering-grade LCA conclusions.

sources.title: Toward a sustainable materials basis of metal-organic frameworks for carbon capture and storage technologies
sources.authors: Jingying Hu; Xiangming Gu; Li-Chiang Lin; Bhavik R. Bakshi
sources.coreIdeaZh: MOF 用于碳捕集时需同时考虑材料性能、合成负担和可持续材料基础。
sources.coreIdeaEn: MOFs for carbon capture require joint consideration of material performance, synthesis burden, and sustainable material basis.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 新增供应/成本/合成负担覆盖审查。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen adds coverage review for supply, cost, and synthesis burden.
sources.boundaryZh: 当前为早筛审查，不替代 TEA 或完整 LCA。
sources.boundaryEn: Current use is early screening, not TEA or complete LCA.

sources.title: MOF adsorbents for flue gas separation: Comparison of material ranking approaches
sources.coreIdeaZh: 吸附剂排序应避免单指标冠军，需显式处理多目标权衡和可比条件。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Adsorbent ranking should avoid single-metric winners and handle multi-objective tradeoffs under comparable conditions.
sources.adoptedInZh: GasSep / EcoScreen 的多指标排序和条件边界说明。
sources.adoptedInEn: Multi-metric ranking and condition-boundary explanations in GasSep / EcoScreen.
sources.boundaryZh: 排序是研究优先级，不是过程性能证明。
sources.boundaryEn: Ranking is research prioritization, not process-performance proof.

sources.title: An experimental strategy for evaluating the energy performance of metal-organic framework-based carbon dioxide adsorbents
sources.coreIdeaZh: 工作容量、吸附热和再生条件会影响吸附过程能耗，不能用容量单独代表过程可用性。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Working capacity, heat of adsorption, and regeneration conditions affect adsorption-process energy, so uptake alone is insufficient.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 新增工作容量、吸附热、再生条件缺口提示。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen adds gap flags for working capacity, heat of adsorption, and regeneration conditions.
sources.boundaryZh: 缺少过程模拟时只显示需求，不计算寄生能。
sources.boundaryEn: Without process simulation, EcoMOF-AI shows requirements rather than calculating parasitic energy.

sources.title: ISO 14040 / ISO 14044 life-cycle assessment standards
sources.coreIdeaZh: LCA 需要目标与范围、功能单位、清单分析、影响评价和解释。
sources.coreIdeaEn: LCA requires goal and scope, functional unit, inventory analysis, impact assessment, and interpretation.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 只显示 LCA 数据准备度，不输出完整 LCA 结论。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen shows LCA readiness rather than complete LCA conclusions.
sources.boundaryZh: 早筛字段不等于标准化 LCA。
sources.boundaryEn: Early-screening fields are not a standards-compliant LCA.

sources.title: USGS critical minerals and EU critical raw materials lists
sources.coreIdeaZh: 关键矿物和关键原料清单适合提示供应链复核，但不直接等于毒性、成本或 LCA 分数。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Critical-mineral and critical-raw-material lists are useful supply-chain review flags, but they are not toxicity, cost, or LCA scores.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 将关键金属作为复核标签，而非直接扣分项。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen treats critical metals as review flags rather than direct score penalties.
sources.boundaryZh: 供应风险必须与候选任务、地区和用量一起解释。
sources.boundaryEn: Supply risk must be interpreted with task, region, and material demand.
